seal.statement: Every exact checkout the push-gate materializer (scripts/checks/push-gate-corpus-worktree.js --gate) proves a command in - the pre-push gate, the publisher's local corpus and post-merge corpus, the local release proof - is brought to the generated state a CI or lab-placed proof checkout has before the command starts: the sealed import graph (test-output/analysis/global-owner-debt-import-graph.json) generated for that commit by its own producer, through one preparation owner that the lab placement shares. A clean checkout of b3b366573 then runs test/scripts/push-gate-change-proof.test.js green through the materializer, where it ran red (subtests 9, 10, 12, 13: import graph is not generated) in the post-merge corpus. A commit whose generated preparation fails or rewrites tracked metadata is refused, never run without it.

text: Cause and history. test/scripts/push-gate-change-proof.test.js reads the sealed import graph (loadSealedImporters(process.cwd()), scripts/checks/helper-import-closure.js) in sealedImportsOf/gateImportClosure, added by 5f6a779e7 (lean-push-gate, 2026-09-12) and cccf0218e (full-corpus-trigger-gate-definers, 2026-10-03); proof-receipt-bound-to-validated-execution (#187) did not introduce it. The graph test-output/analysis/global-owner-debt-import-graph.json is gitignored and generated by scripts/generate-global-owner-debt-inventory.js --refresh-import-graph-only. Its producers today: CI 'Prepare generated test metadata' (npm run test:metadata:refresh), the lab placement script (scripts/lab/probe.js PLACEMENT_IMPORT_GRAPH), the lab selector (prepareSelectorImportGraph), and the pre-push gate's own test stage (postpush manifest step owner-debt-report-inputs). The materializer push-gate-corpus-worktree.js --gate --run <command> generates nothing, so any command other than the hook - the publisher's local and post-merge corpus, the RELEASE.md local release proof - runs in a checkout without it. The file is a spine test, always in the pushing gate's cone where the hook generated the graph; every earlier local corpus ran only the rest of a cone (e.g. 62d537313: 2127 files, file absent; the 19 recorded .files lists contain it 0 times). b3b366573's post-merge run is the first whole-corpus local run (2551 files) and the first to run it unprepared: red on first pass and retry. Reproduced: push-gate-corpus-worktree.js --gate b3b366573 --run node scripts/run-test-files.js test/scripts/push-gate-change-proof.test.js -> not ok 9, 10, 12, 13 (evidence/red-clean-materialized-b3b366573.log.txt).

Live-producer observation for proof-receipt-bound-to-validated-execution: the post-merge whole corpus for b3b366573 (npm run publish -- --post-merge, the first live run of the rebound local-corpus producer) ran red on test/scripts/push-gate-change-proof.test.js on first pass and retry; the run is red, so no corpus-full-v1 receipt is minted (fail-closed, as designed). The same run also showed test/test-helpers/port-allocator.test.js subtest 4 red on first pass (a port held by another socket), recorded here, not absorbed.

New owner scripts/checks/proof-checkout-preparation.js: PROOF_CHECKOUT_GENERATORS (the import graph: scripts/generate-global-owner-debt-inventory.js --refresh-import-graph-only) and prepareProofCheckout(checkout), which runs each producer present in the commit with this node, refuses on a non-zero exit, and puts back the commit's bytes of any tracked file a producer rewrote (a stale seal stays the commit's, so the sealed-graph readers refuse an unsealed graph in their own words). scripts/checks/push-gate-corpus-worktree.js gateExactSha prepares every exact checkout after linking the workspace dependencies and before the command (pre-push gate, publisher local and post-merge corpus, local release proof); scripts/lab/probe.js takes PLACEMENT_IMPORT_GRAPH from the owner's list. test/manifests/pre-push-stages.json materialize stage and CHANGELOG updated. Red first: the clean materialized run at b3b366573 (not ok 9, 10, 12, 13) and test/scripts/proof-checkout-preparation.test.js red with the owner unwired (3 of 4); green: the same materialized run 21 assertions ok, the owner test 4/4, three owner mutations each red, the 36-test generated-material census green through the materializer, touched lane 15/15 assertions=192, test:static 33/33. Paths: scripts/checks/proof-checkout-preparation.js, scripts/checks/push-gate-corpus-worktree.js, scripts/lab/probe.js, test/scripts/proof-checkout-preparation.test.js, test/manifests/pre-push-stages.json, CHANGELOG.md, quest records; derived by the hook: test/shards/*.json.

R17 records. (1) Owner scripts/lab/probe.js: the lab placement's remote script runs the producer but does not keep the commit's bytes of a tracked file the producer rewrites (the materializer now does); a stale seal on a lab machine is left rewritten in its throwaway checkout. Left as is: the remote script is shell, and its preparation list now comes from the one owner. (2) Owner test/scripts (impact-proof-cone-producer, metric-report-inputs, metric-report-provenance): from a checkout under the sandbox's /tmp/claude-1000 scratchpad these three are red with ENOENT stat '/<fixture>/src', prepared or not; they pass in the live post-merge corpus and through the materializer under the repository, so they are location-dependent, not generated-material readers. (3) Cost: every gated command now pays one import-graph generation (about 10 s on this machine) and the pre-push test stage generates it again in its owner-debt-report-inputs step.

Path record for the attempt of 2026-11-02: commit 49132b8c8 also changed solve/changes/global-owner-debt-inventory/inventory.json, derived material the pre-commit hook regenerated (with test/shards/*.json), not named in the attempt's path list. No hand edits.
